item.title: 焦点：預金から国債へ、「金利ある世界」で個人の動き活発 警戒する銀行
item.description: Makiko Yamazaki Mariko Katsumura Noriyuki Hirata Takaya Yama...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
焦点：預金から国債へ、「金利ある世界」で個人の動き活発　警戒する銀行 8:43 配信

写真は円紙幣。10月撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Makiko Yamazaki　Mariko Katsumura　Noriyuki Hirata　Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 政府が強化する個人向け国債の販売に弾みがついてきた。日銀が金融政策の正常化へ動いてから２年半、市場が予想する政策金利の到達点（ターミナルレート）の織り込みが進み、預貯金より高い利回りを確保できる国債へ資金を振り向ける動きが広がっている。過去最高の販売ペースを更新する一方、銀行などからは預金流出による金融仲介機能への影響を懸念する声も出始めた。

大阪府在住の自営業、蒲池崇さん（４６）は８月、中学１年生の長男名義で貯めていたお年玉や入学祝いなど６０万円を個人向け国債で運用し始めた。資金は長男の将来に備え、生まれてから手を付けず郵便貯金に預けていたものだった。

個人向け国債に興味を持ったきっかけは、銀行預金の利息だった。「今まで数十円程度だった利息が１００円単位になっていた。金利のある世界になったと実感した」と振り返る。株式や投資信託も選択肢として考えたが、「（長男には）毎日の値動きに一喜一憂するのではなく、勉強やサッカーに集中してほしかった」として国債を選んだ。

蒲池さん自身も、為替や金利に関する動画などを通じて国債への理解を深めた。円安で毎月の支払い負担が重いドル建て保険は一部すでに解約しており、残る契約についても継続するか、国債に振り向けるか比較検討しているという。

＜過去最高ペースの販売＞

こうした個人の資金シフトは販売現場でも鮮明になっている。

「年１０兆円の販売が視野に入ってきた」。個人向け国債の販売状況について、金融機関の担当者はこう口をそろえる。

財務省が６日発表した１０月発行分の個人向け国債（変動１０年、固定５年、固定３年）は１兆０２５１億円だった。年度ベースでは累計６兆１６４１億円となり、当初計画（５兆９０００億円）をすでに上回った。過去最大だった２００５年度（７兆２７１２億円）を上回るペースにある。

「これまでとは見える景色がだいぶ違ってきた」と楽天証券で個人向け国債の販売を担当する李宗桓債券事業部リーダーは語る。同社で販売する個人向け国債は年初からの半年で前年同期比４．１倍と急拡大したという。

潮目が明らかに変わったのは今年１月ごろ。ベセント米財務長官が日本の金利上昇に厳しい目を向け始めた時期と重なる。

昨年１０月の適用利率が１．０６％だった主力の「変動１０年」は徐々に水準を切り上げ、今年１月には１．２３％に上昇した。ＳＢＩ証券リテールマーケティング部の廣山友梨次長は「（適用利率が）１％を超えてきた辺りから人気が上がってきた。ガラッと金利の水準が変わってきたと受け止められたのではないか」と話す。

＜金利上昇が追い風＞

市中利回りは一進一退を伴いながらも、基本的には上昇基調にある。新発１０年国債利回りは９月に一時３％台に上昇し、足元の変動１０年の適用利率も２％を超える水準となっている。

日銀による利上げの到達点を示すターミナルレートについて、市場の目線は９月に２．５％台まで高まった後も２％台前半で高止まりしている。一方、足元の政策金利は１．２５％で、市場はなお利上げ余地があるとみている。

こうした状況を踏まえ、引き続き預金から個人向け国債へのシフトは続くとＳＢＩ証券リテールマーケティング部の中川貴之部長はみている。

２６年６月時点で家計の金融資産２５１９兆円のうち、現金・預金は１１３２兆円、投資信託は１９３兆円、株式は４８６兆円、債券は３８兆円だった。銀行預金から個人向け国債へ資金が動くことで、債券残高が「投信や株式に近い水準まで増えてくるとうれしい」と中川氏は期待を寄せる。

個人向け国債は１２月募集分から「個人向け国債プラス」に改称し、非営利法人など一部法人向けへの販売も始める。販売の現場からは、需要の拡大を期待する声も聞かれる。

＜預金流出への警戒感＞

一方、預金動向の先行きに対する警戒感もくすぶる。

与野党からは個人国債の販売を後押しする施策を求める声が根強い。相続税を軽減する案や、ＮＩＳＡ（少額投資非課税制度）の対象に加える案も取りざたされる。年末の税制改正協議に先立ち、財務省と金融庁は２０２７年度税制改正要望に個人国債の税優遇を盛り込んでいる。

米国では家計金融資産に占める国債の割合は２％程度とされる。日本は現在１％弱にとどまるが、自然体でも海外並みの水準まで比率が高まる余地がある。実額ベースに換算した買い余力は３０兆円程度に上る。

ただ、それを上回るペースで資金移動が進むことには金融界から懸念もある。税優遇など追加的なインセンティブによって急激な預金流出が起きた場合、「信用創造機能が発揮しづらくなり、今後さらに膨らむ資金需要に十分対応できなくなるリスクがある」（関係者）との見方が出ている。

残るドル建て保険の解約を検討している蒲池さんは、銀行の窓口で定期預金のキャンペーンを紹介された。しかし、預ける最低金額が決まっているなどさまざまな制約があり、国債の条件のほうが魅力的だったという。「国債の方が何倍も、下手したら４、５倍、国債の方がいいと思った。金利のある世界で、僕から見たら国債のほうがいい」。

首相肝入りの成長投資を加速する上では、金融機関による仲介機能が欠かせない。過度な税優遇はかえって資金配分の不均衡を招き、成長経済への移行を阻む可能性もある。

ハッカーコードのイメージ。10月30日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic（ロイター） Mathieu Rosemain　Elizabeth Howcroft　Mateusz Rabiega

[パリ ５日 ロイター] - フランスの銀行クレディ・ミュチュエル・アルケアは５日、前日に発表したサイバー攻撃で約１億ユーロ（約１億１２６０万ドル）が盗まれ、資金回収に取り組んでいると明らかにした。

クレディ・ミュチュエル・アルケアは４日、ハッカーが同行名義の口座を使って「不正取引」を行ったと発表。盗まれた資金は暗号資産ではなかったが、盗難後に暗号資産に換えられた可能性があるという。同行は予防措置として一部の取引を停止し、送金に遅れが出たケースもあった。ただ、顧客資産に影響はなかったとしている。

また、同行の広報担当者は、オンライン銀行子会社フォルチュネオが侵入口になったとの報道を否定した。

パリ検察は、サイバー犯罪部門が４日にクレディ・ミュチュエル・アルケアからの被害届を受け、直ちに捜査を開始したと明らかにした。捜査は警察が主導しているという。

サイバーセキュリティー会社レッドセックラボのラファイ・バローチ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は、クレディ・ミュチュエルへの攻撃は欧州では前例がないとし、「アプリケーション層を狙う高度な攻撃や、人の心理や行動を巧みに利用する高度なソーシャルエンジニアリング攻撃が、銀行を標的に数多く行われている」と語った。

先週には暗号資産（仮想通貨）交換所バイナンスから６３億ドル相当の暗号資産が盗まれたほか、欧州ではインターネットに接続された冷蔵庫を狙うサイバー攻撃が相次いでいる。

9月実質賃金は前年比2.2％増、9カ月連続プラスは9年ぶりの長さ＝毎勤統計 8:38 配信

都内で10月撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Tetsushi Kajimoto

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 厚生労働省が６日に公表した９月の毎月勤労統計によると、名目賃金から物価変動の影響を除いた実質賃金は前年比２．２％増加した。前年比プラスは９カ月連続で、２０１７年１月までの１２カ月連続以来の長さ。上昇を続けていた物価が高止まりの状態となった一方、企業収益の拡大などに支えられて名目賃金が伸長していることが背景にあり、厚労省は賃上げの好循環が続くのか「物価の動向と合わせて要注視」としている。

消費者物価指数（持家の帰属家賃を除く総合） は２．４％上昇。前年は３－４％台の上昇率が続いていたが、今年に入ってからは１－２％台での推移で落ち着いている。

一方、名目賃金（現金給与総額）は前年比４．６％増と５７カ月連続のプラスで、伸び率としては１９９７年１月以来の高さだった。このうち基本給などに当たる所定内給与は同３．７％増と、前月の３．８％増からは若干伸びが鈍ったものの高水準を維持。残業代などの所定外給与も、人手不足を反映し３．６％増加した。

ボーナスなどの特別に支払われた賞与は、好調な企業業績を反映し３２．６％増と大幅な伸びとなった。特に、６月から８月に特別に支払われた給与（夏のボーナス）は前年同期比５．３％増と、比較可能な２０１３年以降で最も高い伸びを記録した。

厚労省は賃上げペースの持続性の背景には春闘の影響があるとみて、注視したいとしている。連合は先月、２０２７年春闘で要求する賃上げ率（定期昇給込み）について、「６％中心、５％以上」とする基本構想を発表した。

TOKYO, Nov 6 : Japan's real wages rose 2.2 per cent in September from a year earlier, marking the ninth consecutive month of gains, government data showed on Friday, supporting the case for the Bank of Japan to keep raising interest rates. • Growth in real, or inflation-adjusted, pay picked up from August's revised 1.6 per cent gain. • Average nominal wages, or total cash earnings, rose 4.6 per cent to 311,409 yen ($1,972.94), the fastest rise since January 1997 and up from August's revised 3.9 per cent growth. • Workers' base salaries, or regular pay, increased 3.7 per cent, roughly in line with the 3.8 per cent gain in August. A deal would take private one of the largest providers of software tools used to create video games and other real-time 3D applications. It would rank among the biggest leveraged buyouts in the software sector in recent years. SILVER LAKE, PIF TIES TO GAMING Silver Lake and PIF have partnered on major gaming deals before. The EA take-private, which also included Affinity Partners, was among the largest leveraged buyouts ever. Unity’s game engine and developer tools are already used by Scopely, the developer behind “Monopoly Go!,” and Niantic, the creator of “Pokemon Go.” Both are owned by a group that includes PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Partners. Silver Lake, one of the world’s largest technology-focused private equity firms, has a long-standing relationship with Unity. It invested up to $400 million in the company in 2017 and remains among its largest shareholders. Silver Lake’s Egon Durban also sits on Unity’s board, a dual role that would typically lead him to recuse himself from board deliberations on a sale. Unity on Thursday reported third-quarter results that beat Wall Street estimates, helped by strong growth in its advertising and game-development businesses. Revenue rose 32 per cent to $622.1 million, and adjusted earnings were 44 cents per share. Strong growth in Unity’s AI-powered Vector advertising platform helped it post its first quarterly profit on a GAAP basis since going public in September 2020. San Francisco-based Unity makes the software engine behind thousands of mobile, console and PC games, and its technology is increasingly used in automotive design, filmmaking, architecture and industrial simulation. Its platform lets developers create and run interactive 3D content across multiple devices and operating systems. Founded in Denmark in 2004, Unity since going public has expanded beyond its core game engine business into advertising technology and broader real-time 3D software.

Nov 5 (Reuters) – Ukraine must adapt to the new realities of US politics to build dialogue and address its needs for more foreign aid and bolstered air defences to counter Russian attacks, President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said in an interview broadcast on Thursday.

Zelenskiy has made considerable effort to smooth over a volatile relationship with US President Donald Trump, particularly after a February 2025 Oval Office meeting during which he was accused of being ungrateful for Washington’s aid.

Zelenskiy, attending an Ibero-American summit in Spain, told Ukrainian television channel TSN that Kyiv had to adapt to a changed US political landscape after voters in US midterm elections put Democrats in control of Congress.

TOKYO, Nov 6 : For years, Japanese savers left their cash in bank accounts that paid next to nothing because few things paid much more. With government bonds now yielding four times as much as deposits, that no longer holds and banks are starting to worry. When the Bank of Japan last week declared victory in its near 14-year battle to lift inflation to its 2 per cent target, it closed a long chapter of near-zero interest rates. Now, rising bond yields are making households more sensitive to returns on their money, fuelling a boom in government bond purchases and prompting some to shift a portion of the $7 trillion they hold out of bank deposits. Takashi Kamachi, a 46-year-old self-employed businessman in Osaka, recently moved 600,000 yen ($3,785.01) of his teenage son's gift money, held for years in a Japan Post Bank account, into retail government bonds (JGBs).

"Banks are promoting time deposits again, but I thought government bonds looked far more attractive, perhaps four or five times better in terms of returns," he said. To be sure, the shift is still modest. However, policymakers hope households will eventually play a bigger role in funding Japan's massive budget as stable holders of government debt, and help fill a hole left by the BOJ's diminishing JGB purchases. "Foreign investors can help fill the gap, but what Japan really needs is a stable buyer base, and that means households," said Kenji Nakanishi, a senior ruling party lawmaker and key advocate of expanding retail ownership of government bonds. 'INTEREST RATES EXIST' Retail Japanese government bond sales in the April-October period have nearly doubled from a year earlier to 6 trillion yen. Over last three consecutive months, monthly sales have exceeded 1 trillion yen, as yields on popular retail bonds climbed above 2 per cent, far outstripping bank deposit rates that mostly remain below 1 per cent. "People are starting to realise that interest rates exist," said Takayuki Nakagawa, general manager of retail marketing at SBI Securities, Japan's largest seller of retail government bonds. Many buyers are first-time investors seeking a safe alternative to bank deposits, according to Nakagawa. Drawn by a government guarantee of principal, they represent the same conservative savers banks have traditionally relied on for funding, he said. Despite the BOJ lifting its policy rates, commercial banks have kept deposit rates low to minimise funding costs, offering around 0.5 per cent on one-year deposits, not enough to beat inflation. In contrast, 3- and 5-year retail notes and 10-year floaters all offer coupons above 2 per cent. Japanese households hold roughly 2.50 quadrillion yen in financial assets, according to BOJ data, with cash and deposits accounting for about 1.13 quadrillion yen. Even with that demand, household holdings of government bonds account for less than 1 per cent of their financial assets, compared with roughly 2 per cent for US households' holdings of Treasury securities. JGBs must also compete with global and domestic equities, which have already attracted a steady stream of funds from younger investors seeking higher returns. Eager to find sources of revenue to fund their spending, some lawmakers want to make JGBs more attractive, such as through longer-duration products and incentives such as inheritance-tax benefits. "Now that momentum is finally building, this is exactly the time to give it an extra push," Nakanishi said. Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama wants to improve the appeal of retail government bonds. Her ministry, for one, is studying the launch of additional retail bond products, it said on Thursday, while also calling for discussions on preferential tax treatment for buyers. PUSHBACK The idea, however, faces pushback from some lawmakers who fret it would widen income disparity by benefiting already wealthy households. Meanwhile, commercial banks fear a shift into bonds could drain deposits, leaving less ammunition to profit from increasing borrowing demand. Some bank officials say they are already seeing once loyal customers shift money into JGBs. "Preferential treatment for retail government bonds would be a problem," said a senior regional bank official, who requested anonymity. Bank lending has consistently outpaced deposit growth this year, with loans rising 5-6 per cent from a year earlier while deposits grew only around 2 per cent, according to BOJ data, forcing lenders to compete more aggressively for household savings. "A rapid and excessive shift of funds from bank deposits into retail government bonds could weaken the credit-creation function banks are responsible for and affect their ability to supply growth capital to the economy," Mizuho Bank head Masahiko Kato, who is also chair of a banking lobby, said in September. There are also questions about financing Japan's huge debt with household savings. Foreign investors have increased their presence in the JGB market, raising concerns that yields could become more vulnerable to sharp swings in global sentiment. The BOJ's share of the JGB and T-bill market has fallen to 41.2 per cent in June 2026 from a peak of 47.9 per cent in December 2023, as it tapered bond purchases to unwind monetary stimulus. Banks' share has more than halved to 17.8 per cent since 2013, when the BOJ deployed a huge asset-buying scheme. Takero Doi, a professor at Keio University, said instead of boosting retail bond demand, policymakers should focus on reducing government debt. "You could simply end up seeing households replacing banks as buyers of retail government bonds," he said. "That won't solve the underlying problem." ($1 = 158.5200 yen)

CAIRO, Nov 5 (Reuters) – Two Egyptian army officers, including a high-ranking border guard officer, were killed during a military crackdown on illegal gold mining along Egypt’s southern border with Sudan, a military spokesperson said on Thursday.

The military launched the campaign to counter illegal gold mining in the Eastern Desert in June, with the first three phases complete.  The military said the fourth phase was due to begin on Saturday, adding the campaign intended to strengthen state control over Egyptian territory and protect national resources.

It was not immediately clear when the two officers were killed, and the spokesperson did not specify the timing of their deaths.

The military spokesperson said authorities had detained 151 Egyptians and 540 foreigners during the campaign.

The campaign has drawn attention after the rights monitor Emergency Lawyers said in October that at least 72 artisanal miners had been killed in an airstrike in northern Sudan, close to the Egyptian border. The group blamed the Egyptian Air Force for the strike.

Egypt’s military did not refer to the reported strike or the deaths at the time. In a statement then, it said a phase of its campaign against illegal gold mining in southern Egypt was under way after it dropped warning leaflets on what it described as “criminal elements.”

Artisanal gold mining has risen in northern Sudan since Sudan’s civil war disrupted livelihoods. Gold has become a key revenue source during the conflict, while experts and industry participants say much of it is smuggled into Egypt through a porous and disputed border area that includes the mineral-rich Halayeb and Shalateen regions.

The Egyptian military spokesperson said there was coordination with Sudan, including recent meetings between Egyptian and Sudanese officials. He said the armed forces of both countries exchanged information on securing the Egypt-Sudan border.
